system_thesis_interpretation: V10R1 exactly resolves every V10-consensus-required local change without altering the experiment or its C11 boundary. It preserves the complete V9 experiment through the V10 layer, deliberately retains V10's line-anchored and ASCII-only byte choices, makes OFF multiple-ACT diagnostic-only, binds the two U+00A0 divergence negatives, and states the complete deterministic shortcut domain. These are reducer, fixture, and maximum-wording determinations for the same supervised seen-key writer-capacity scout; they do not change fitting, scored geometry, model visibility, resource limits, cognitive architecture, or the exclusions on mechanism, memory, generalization, parenting, whole-organism, and C11 claims.
graph_delta_interpretation: The multiple-ACT node is now unambiguous: the metric is computed over each fixed 64-output root-condition multiset, but only the four root-map adapter conditions are gate-bearing and each must have zero occurrences; an OFF occurrence remains visible and reportable yet cannot affect interface_ok or any final label. The output grammar deliberately uses V10's exact-case protocol-line predicate and removes only boundary bytes 0x20, 0x09, 0x0d, and 0x0a for both primary and native equality, with no Unicode normalization or Unicode-whitespace stripping. Therefore valid-UTF-8 U+00A0-wrapped otherwise-exact primary and native outputs fail their respective comparisons. The shortcut-to-claim edge now names all five deterministic families and every declared non-key categorical surface covariate alone and crossed with mode on each frozen scored multiset, exactly matching the evidence domain.
loop_delta_interpretation: The experimental loop is unchanged: two engineered roots, four clean-base root-map fits, sixteen seen keys per adapter, the inherited primary, oracle, spill, native-interface, metric, precedence, and evidence rules, and the later 3.0 A40-hour cap all remain intact. V10R1 changes only deterministic interpretation and CPU discrimination around complete output bytes and claim rendering. It neither completes nor enforces the final guard and authorizes no tokenizer, model, training, adapter, benchmark, GPU, resource, lineage, parenting, claim, release, submission, or C11 action. After exact human ratification, the most that may be authorized is the three named implementation files, deterministic CPU tests and receipts, and two V10R1-local reviews; model execution remains a separate later decision.
claim_delta_interpretation: The maximum pass wording now carries the full supported quantifiers. In each of all four root-map adapters, all 16 per-key median action-choice NLL gains must pass, whereas directional margins remain deliberately partial and separately gate each adapter at at least 12/16 keys and 6/8 per stratum. On each frozen scored multiset, maximum target balanced accuracy must be exactly 1/2 for constant, tool-only, mode-only, stratum-only, and stratum-by-mode deterministic policy families and for every declared non-key categorical surface-covariate predictor both alone and crossed with mode. The resulting conclusion excludes only those enumerated behavioral policies on the evaluated surface; it is not a fitted shortcut-probe, representation, mechanism, independent-memory, generalization, learning, parenting, or whole-organism result. Spill and native-interface language remains bounded by the predeclared tests.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The visibility contract is scientifically appropriate and unchanged except for making the intended use explicit. Complete OFF outputs remain visible to recording, reduction, and independent review; OFF multiple-ACT may be reported as a diagnostic but is derived-only at claim rendering and forbidden from changing interface_ok or the label. Adapter outputs remain visible for four separate zero-occurrence gates over their fixed 64-item multisets. The deterministic shortcut table remains forbidden from model requests, is available to reduction and review, and may reach the claim renderer only through the exact enumerated statement. Inherited native expected outputs remain unavailable to fitting, request construction, the request recorder, and the primary reducer.
acceptance_test_interpretation: MWG10R1_T01 must prove the exact three-layer hashes and that only the adjudicated local predicate, OFF, U+00A0, and claim-quantifier choices supersede inherited text. MWG10R1_T02, together with the incorporated V10 obligations carried by MWG10R1_T03, must distinguish offset-zero and post-LF protocol lines after optional ASCII space/tab from inline, repeated-same-line, lowercase, and CR-only cases; preserve indented, malformed-line, LF, case, missing, extra-text, fixed-denominator, and strict native 8/8 cases; reject valid-UTF-8 U+00A0 boundary wrappers for both primary and native scoring; leave an otherwise applicable label unchanged when only OFF has multiple_ACT=true; and yield INTERFACE_INVALID at inherited precedence when an adapter alone violates the zero-occurrence gate. MWG10R1_T03 must also retain every MWG9/MWG10 geometry, visibility, metric, label, integrity, parser, inheritance, four-adapter key-median, partial directional-count, spill, native, and claim-domain obligation without real tokenizer, model, trainer, adapter, or GPU use. MWG10R1_T04 correctly requires a fresh independent implementation review and separate scientific advocate over identical bound evidence, with independent rejection controlling before any later execution ratification.
